notes: Invest Like the Best had no transcript and is scored on metadata only. Claims are as stated by speakers and not yet fact-checked.

episodes.title: Jensen Huang | Does AI Revenue Justify Capex, '27 AI Bottlenecks, Singularity, Open vs Closed & more
episodes.reason: Jensen firsthand: lab revenue must go $200B→$400B→$800B to pay back capex; Vera Rubin at ~$50B/GW vs $5B for CPU compute. Operator-level numbers, partly checkable.

claims.claim: Huang says frontier plus inference lab revenue is about $200B this year and must double to $400B next year and $800B after to approach payback on AI capex.
claims.speaker: Jensen Huang

claims.claim: Huang frames a Vera Rubin gigawatt at roughly $50B versus about $5B per GW for general-purpose compute, betting it delivers 10x+ more value.
claims.speaker: Jensen Huang

claims.claim: Huang credits Claude Code with a 10x unlock in AI usage this year, with labs growing revenue 2-3x annually.
claims.speaker: Jensen Huang

claims.claim: Nvidia's physical-AI business did about $10B over the last year, its first $10B year.
claims.speaker: Jensen Huang

episodes.title: Ep. 039 - [EMERGENCY] Brad Gerstner Cut Our 2027 Forecast in Half. We Raised It. (Datacenters)
episodes.reason: SemiAnalysis raises its 43 GW 2027 datacenter forecast against a ~25 GW consensus, built from site-level tracking incl. 400+ moratoriums. Checkable, material to AI infra names.

claims.claim: SemiAnalysis is raising, not cutting, its 43 GW 2027 datacenter capacity forecast despite Gerstner calling it too aggressive.
claims.speaker: host (SemiAnalysis)

claims.claim: Bear case sits near 25 GW for 2027, driven by moratorium and grid-connection fears.
claims.speaker: host (SemiAnalysis)

claims.claim: SemiAnalysis cross-checked over 400 local datacenter moratoriums against its site list and found little impact on 2027 capacity.
claims.speaker: SemiAnalysis analyst

episodes.title: Don Wilson on the GPU Market's Trillion Dollar Question
episodes.reason: DRW's Don Wilson on GPU futures: CFTC comment period means compute futures can list Nov 9 absent action; neocloud credit stress shows need for hedging. Firsthand market-structure news.

claims.claim: GPU compute futures can list on November 9 if the CFTC takes no action during the extended comment period.
claims.speaker: Don Wilson

claims.claim: Wilson argues neoclouds without creditworthy counterparties face real risk and need GPU price hedging products.
claims.speaker: Don Wilson

claims.claim: Wilson expects Nvidia to lose some market share but remain dominant.
claims.speaker: Don Wilson

claims.claim: DRW is building a 'crunch spread' and eventually token futures on model output.
claims.speaker: Don Wilson

episodes.title: CME's Terry Duffy on the Disconcerting State of Finance Regulation
episodes.reason: CME CEO firsthand on regulation: 2,500 CFTC self-certifications, none denied; CME litigating vs perps. Relevant to CME/prediction markets, light on numbers.

claims.speaker: Terry Duffy
